correctness.rationale: The divisor intersection form uniquely fixes the 27-line skew graph; the verifier checks its (27,16,10,8) parameters and enumerates all 2,763 faces and 10,584 incidences. The declared deterministic matching comprises 1,368 disjoint legal facet pairs, and a complete topological sort proves its directed Hasse diagram acyclic. Exactly one critical zero-cell and 26 critical four-cells remain. Forman yields a CW complex with this cell inventory, hence exactly a wedge of 26 four-spheres; no unverified Smith invariants or infinite enumeration extrapolation is used. Output VERIFY_OK was obtained from packaged verify.py and preserved verbatim.

value.rationale: For the canonical 27-line Schläfli/GQ(2,4) configuration, the natural complex of compatible simultaneous line blow-down choices is nonpure and has 2,763 faces and maximal simplices in two dimensions. The theorem determines its full integral homotopy type and torsion-free status rather than its Euler characteristic, f-vector, or first homology, and provides a complete explicit finite acyclic-Morse certificate. This is an exact geometric/topological invariant of a historically important E6 configuration with plausible use in comparing complex geometry and finite graph topology; no unsupported generalization is claimed.
